page_title: Don't Let AI Write For You

sources.entry: Don't Let AI Write For You

summary.title: Don't Let AI Write For You
summary.one_liner: Writing is a way to build understanding and credibility, so letting an LLM write your documents skips the thinking that makes you stronger and trusted.
keywords: when to use llms in writing
takeaways: The main purpose of writing is to deepen your own understanding and then share it with others, not just to produce text.
Relying on LLM-generated documents skips the effortful thinking that builds writing and reasoning skill.
LLM-generated documents can signal to colleagues that you did not engage with the ideas, which harms credibility.
LLMs are useful for research, checking work, and generating ideas, since discarding weak suggestions costs little.
Software efficiency gains from LLMs need to be matched by greater thoughtfulness.
summary.summary: This short opinion essay argues against using LLMs to write documents such as PRDs, technical specs, and essays. The author frames writing as answering a question and as a way to build understanding, comparing LLM-written prose to paying someone else to work out for you. It also argues that LLM-generated text undermines personal credibility and the perceived authenticity of the underlying thinking. The piece closes by suggesting LLMs are better suited to research, checking work, and idea generation than to drafting the writing itself.
